items.title: Flying & Gliding
items.description: Air experience flights and gliding opportunities in Viking gliders through the RAFAC Air Experience Flying programme with oppotunities to gain private pilots wings.

items.title: Shooting
items.description: Smallbore and air rifle shooting, with the opportunity to compete at wing, regional and national level.

items.title: Adventure Training
items.description: Hiking, climbing, kayaking and more across Dartmoor and the UK - including Duke of Edinburgh Award expeditions at all levels.

items.title: Precision & pride
items.description: Develop focus, teamwork and pride through regular drill practice and ceremonial events.

items.title: BTEC Qualifications
items.description: Earn nationally recognised qualifications in Space Studies and Public Services through the RAFAC BTEC programme.

items.title: Leadership
items.description: Progress through the cadet ranks and develop real leadership skills that will serve you for life.
